figurative_meaning_en: To fall into deep trouble or crisis
similar_in_english: Out of the frying pan into the fire
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় ফেল করার পর তার জীবন দহে পড়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: Due to his business losses, he has fallen into the fire.
After failing the exam, his life fell into deep crisis.
note: The idiom draws from imagery of fire pits, common in rural Bengali folklore for expressing peril.
